description: Land Acquisition - Urubokka, Pasgoda D/S Division, Matara District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically detailing the acquisition of various land parcels and servitudes for public purposes. It contains detailed descriptions of land lots, their locations, claimants, and extents, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
